name: Stuffed Mushrooms
description: A savory appetizer of mushroom caps filled with a creamy mixture of bacon, cream cheese, and Parmesan.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the crumbled bacon, cream cheese, Parmesan cheese, and Worcestershire sauce together.
Stuff the mixture into the mushroom caps.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.

keywords: stuffed mushrooms, appetizer, bacon, cream cheese

_similar.name: Chili Con Queso (Nacho Cheese Dip)
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy dip made with cream cheese, cheddar cheese soup, and processed cheese, perfect for tortilla chips.
recipeIngredient: 10 oz can (284 mL) cheddar cheese soup

recipeInstructions.text: Let the cream cheese stand at room temperature to warm up.
In a saucepan, melt the cream cheese over heat.
Add the cheddar cheese soup, stirring constantly until well combined.
Crumble the processed cheese into smaller pieces and melt it into the cheese mixture.
Add salsa to taste, adjusting the amount based on the type of salsa used.
Serve the Chili Con Queso hot with tortilla chips as a dip, or cold with tacos or chili.

_similar.keywords: nacho cheese dip, chili con queso, cheesy dip, tortilla chip dip

_similar.name: Stuffed Pita Pockets
_similar.description: A refreshing appetizer featuring mini pita pockets filled with a creamy ranch and feta cheese mixture, topped with cucumbers and tomatoes.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the softened cream cheese, mayonnaise, and powdered ranch dressing mix until well combined.
Crumble feta cheese into the cream cheese mixture and stir to combine.
Cut the mini pita pockets in half and fill with the cheese mixture.
Top with diced cucumbers and tomatoes.
Serve and enjoy.

_similar.keywords: pita pockets, ranch dip, feta cheese, appetizer

_similar.name: Party Salmon Ball
_similar.description: A classic chilled salmon and cream cheese ball coated in crunchy nuts and parsley.
recipeIngredient: 1 (16 oz) can salmon, drained and flaked

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together except for the nuts and parsley.
Shape the mixture into a ball.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours (but no longer than 4 days).
Roll the ball in a mixture of nuts and parsley to coat evenly before serving.

_similar.keywords: salmon ball, cheese ball, party dip, holiday appetizer

_similar.name: Cheese English Muffins
_similar.description: Toasted English muffin quarters topped with a rich cheese and bacon mixture.
recipeIngredient: ½ lb sharp yellow cheese, grated

recipeInstructions.text: Mix grated cheese, mayonnaise, Worcestershire sauce, crumbled bacon, and chopped onion together.
Slice English muffins into quarters.
Spread the cheese mixture onto the English muffin quarters.
Bake at 400°F for 10 minutes.

_similar.name: Fairest Wheels
_similar.description: A chilled, rolled tortilla snack filled with a spicy chicken and cheese mixture.
recipeIngredient: ⅔ cup chopped green bell pepper
⅓ cup minced green onions and red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine chicken, lettuce, cheddar cheese.
In another bowl, beat cream cheese and sour cream together until smooth.
Add the cream cheese mixture to the chicken mixture and mix well.
Spread ⅓ cup of the chicken and cream cheese mixture onto one side of a tortilla, leaving a ½-inch border at the top.
Sprinkle with ⅓ cup shredded cheese and top with red pepper jelly.
Roll up the tortilla tightly and seal the edge.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling mixture.
Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Trim the ends off each roll and cut into 8 slices.
Serve cold.

_similar.keywords: chicken roll-ups, cheese snack, cold appetizer
